title: group~

methods.description: non zero sets to gain compensation mode

body: [group~] groups 'n' channels from a multichannel input and sums it. The argument sets the number of output channels. The input is then broken into groups of n channels and summed. For instance "1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6" grouped in a 3 channel output gives us "1+4, 2+5, 3+6" (5, 7, 9). There's a gain compensation factor, set via the 2nd argument or the 'gain' message, which divides by the number of summed channels. In the same example we then divide the output by 2 (giving us "2.5 3.5 4.5").
